name: Maidhem
source:
Walking alone one night you are kidnapped and brought to an ominous manor and then... forgotten?! Now the manors maids have remembered you and need to figure out what to do with you! Escape or be killed by the manor and it's c̶u̶t̶e̶ staff over and over in this monster maid experience!

[From [url=https://zeddybear.itch.io/maidhem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某个独自夜行的晚上，你遭人绑架带进了一座阴森诡异的庄园，紧接着…居然被绑架者彻底忘在脑后了？！如今庄园里的女仆们总算想起了还有你这么号人，正琢磨着该如何处置你！在这场魔物女仆惊魂体验中，要么设法逃出生天，要么被这座庄园及其可̶爱̶的女仆员工们一次又一次地残忍杀死吧！

[摘自[url=https://zeddybear.itch.io/maidhem]Itch.io[/url]]
